es: Enlazar frases sin repetir palabras con this/such, the former/the latter, the same y respectively, y señalar hacia atrás y hacia delante.

teaching.en: Cars and bicycles both create problems: the former pollute the air, and the latter block the pavements.
teaching.es: Los coches y las bicicletas crean problemas: los primeros contaminan el aire y las segundas bloquean las aceras.
teaching.explanationEs: The former = el primero de los dos citados; the latter = el segundo.
segments: Cars and bicycles both create problems: the former pollute
the air, and the latter block the pavements.
teaching.audioText: Cars and bicycles both create problems: the former pollute the air, and the latter block the pavements.

teaching.en: The council banned cars from the centre. This decision surprised many shop owners.
teaching.es: El ayuntamiento prohibió los coches en el centro. Esta decisión sorprendió a muchos comerciantes.
teaching.explanationEs: This + sustantivo resume la idea de la frase anterior sin repetirla.
segments: The council banned cars from the centre.
This decision surprised many shop owners.
teaching.audioText: The council banned cars from the centre. This decision surprised many shop owners.

teaching.en: Such a decision is rarely popular at first, yet the results usually justify it.
teaching.es: Una decisión así rara vez es popular al principio, pero los resultados suelen justificarla.
teaching.explanationEs: Such a + sustantivo = «una … así»; no se dice «such decision» sin artículo.
segments: Such a decision is rarely popular at
first, yet the results usually justify it.
teaching.audioText: Such a decision is rarely popular at first, yet the results usually justify it.

teaching.en: Shop owners and residents asked for parking and quiet, respectively.
teaching.es: Los comerciantes y los vecinos pidieron aparcamiento y silencio, respectivamente.
teaching.explanationEs: Respectively une dos listas en el mismo orden: comerciantes → aparcamiento, vecinos → silencio.
teaching.audioText: Shop owners and residents asked for parking and quiet, respectively.

teaching.en: The buses were late on Monday, and the same happened on Tuesday.
teaching.es: Los autobuses llegaron tarde el lunes y lo mismo ocurrió el martes.
teaching.explanationEs: The same happened evita repetir toda la frase anterior.
segments: The buses were late on Monday,
and the same happened on Tuesday.
teaching.audioText: The buses were late on Monday, and the same happened on Tuesday.

teaching.en: The previous report named two causes; the following sections explain them.
teaching.es: El informe anterior nombró dos causas; las secciones siguientes las explican.
teaching.explanationEs: Previous apunta hacia atrás; the following apunta hacia delante.
segments: The previous report named two causes;
teaching.audioText: The previous report named two causes; the following sections explain them.

prompt.es: Completa: «Coches y bicis: los primeros contaminan y las segundas estorban.»

feedback.es: The former designa el primero de los dos elementos citados y the latter el segundo.

origin.text: Cars and bikes cause problems: the ___ pollute and the latter block pavements.

prompt.es: Elige la versión que evita repetir la idea de la primera frase.

choices.text: The council banned cars. The council banned cars surprised everyone.
The council banned cars. Such surprised everyone.
The council banned cars. This decision surprised everyone.

feedback.es: This decision resume la frase anterior; las otras opciones repiten la idea o rompen la gramática.

hint.es: Usa this + un sustantivo que resuma la idea.

origin.text: Original: The council banned cars. The council's banning of cars surprised everyone.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Una decisión así rara vez es popular al principio.»

answer.text: Such a decision is rarely popular at first

feedback.es: Such a + sustantivo califica la decisión como «una así» y lleva artículo.

hint.es: Such va antes de a decision.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que usa bien the former y the latter.

choices.text: Tea and coffee are popular: the former is calming, and the latter gives energy.
Tea and coffee are popular: the later is calming, and the latter gives energy.
Tea is popular: the former is calming, and the latter gives energy.

feedback.es: The former y the latter necesitan dos elementos citados antes, y se escriben latter, no later.

prompt.es: Completa: «Comerciantes y vecinos pidieron aparcamiento y silencio, respectivamente.»

feedback.es: Respectively empareja los dos sujetos con las dos peticiones en el mismo orden.

origin.text: Shop owners and residents asked for parking and quiet, ___.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige a qué se refiere «such a schedule».

choices.text: To the closing time of the library.
To opening on both Monday and Tuesday.
To the price of a museum ticket.

feedback.es: Such a schedule resume lo dicho antes: abrir lunes y martes, algo raro porque casi todo cierra los lunes.

origin.audio: The museum opened on Monday and Tuesday. The same happened at the library. Such a schedule is unusual, because most places close on Mondays.

prompt.es: Elige la mejor reescritura de las tres frases repetitivas sobre el tranvía.

choices.text: The city built a tram. The tram affected the tram.
The city built a tram. Former affected commuting and shopping.
The city built a tram. This change affected both commuting and shopping.

feedback.es: This change condensa las dos frases repetidas en una referencia clara.

origin.text: Original: The city built a tram. The tram changed commuting. The tram changed shopping.

prompt.es: Completa: «Un plan así necesita mucho dinero.»

feedback.es: Such a + sustantivo equivale a «un … así» y abre la frase con mayúscula.

origin.text: ___ a plan needs a lot of money.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ventaja tienen las bicis.

choices.text: They are low-cost and fast for short distances.
They can carry a larger number of people.

feedback.es: The former remite a las bicis, el primer elemento citado; los autobuses, the latter, llevan más gente.

origin.audio: Bikes and buses both help the city. The former are cheap and quick for short trips, while the latter carry more people.

prompt.es: Reescribe las tres frases en dos, sin repetir «the longer lunch break».

answer.text: The school introduced a longer lunch break. This change made students happier and also helped teachers.
accepted: The school introduced a longer lunch break. This change made students happier and also helped teachers.
The school introduced a longer lunch break. Such a change made students happier, and it also helped teachers.
The school introduced a longer lunch break, which made students happier and also helped teachers.

feedback.es: Una referencia como this change o such a change sustituye la repetición y junta los dos efectos.

origin.text: Original: The school introduced a longer lunch break. The longer lunch break made students happier. The longer lunch break also helped teachers.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Lo primero es más rápido, pero lo segundo es más barato.»

answer.text: The former is faster but the latter is cheaper

feedback.es: The former y the latter mantienen el orden de los dos elementos citados antes.

prompt.es: Elige la frase correcta con such.

choices.text: Such change is rarely easy a.
Such a change is rarely easy.
A such change is rarely easy.

feedback.es: Such se coloca antes del artículo: such a change; a such change no existe.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada recurso con su función.

feedback.es: Cada recurso cumple un papel: resumir, elegir el segundo de dos, emparejar en orden o anunciar lo que sigue.
